title: Weld Tech Group - Capacitive Equipment Manufacturing
meta_description: Design and manufacturing of tanks and containers up to 20 m³ for liquids, bulk materials and gasesReliable hermetic welding, custom solutions.
main_description: We manufacture various types of tanks and containers for storing liquids, bulk materials and gases.

volume.title: Containers up to 20 m³ are manufactured entirely in-house (larger volumes available on order).

custom.title: We design and manufacture containers in non-standard shapes and sizes, adapted to the dimensions and specifications of customer premises.

materials.title: Materials used:
materials.stainless: High-alloy steels: AISI-304L, AISI-308L, AISI-316L, AISI-321
materials.aluminum: Aluminum and its alloys: AL, AMG, AMC

environments.title: Typical storage environments and products:
environments.liquids: Water, propylene glycol, alcohol, beer, milk and dairy products
environments.chemicals: Acids, alkalis, petroleum products, gases, compressed air and others

bottom_description: When needed, mixers, cooling or heating jackets are mounted in containers (heat carrier can be liquid or electric current). Welding is performed by WIG-TIG, MIG-MAG methods, ensuring high reliability and hermeticity.

realisations.title: Our Realizations
realisations.description: Each of our projects reflects precise fulfillment of customer requirements, well-thought-out economic model and flawless technical execution.
